parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Magnesium reacts with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.

State **two** observations that would be made when magnesium is heated strongly and placed in a gas jar of pure oxygen.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Acid indigestion is caused by an excess of hydrochloric acid in the stomach. Magnesium oxide is commonly found in indigestion tablets.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Give the equation to show how magnesium oxide relieves acid indigestion.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that occurs in **(b)(i)**.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Magnesium oxide is described as a ceramic material. It has a high melting point.

State and explain why ceramic materials such as magnesium oxide have high melting points.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Magnesium oxide can be made from magnesium carbonate in a one-step reaction using heat.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: Write an equation for this reaction. Include state symbols.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction occurring during this process.
